gaps.sentence: Ice ___ if you leave it in the sun.
gaps.explanation: In zero conditionals both clauses use the present simple: melts.

gaps.sentence: If you order before midnight, delivery ___ nothing.
gaps.hint: result clause of a first conditional
gaps.explanation: The result of a real future condition takes 'will': will cost.

gaps.sentence: You will not pass the course unless you ___ all the assignments.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces a negative condition and takes the present simple: complete.

gaps.sentence: If we ___ a map, we would have arrived hours ago.
gaps.hint: unreal past condition with past perfect
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had brought.

gaps.sentence: If we had left earlier, we ___ the ferry.
gaps.hint: unreal past, would have plus participle
gaps.explanation: Third conditionals take 'would have' plus the past participle in the result clause: would have caught.

gaps.sentence: Unless you ___ the form by Friday, your application will not be considered.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' means 'if not' and, like if, takes the present simple: submit.

gaps.sentence: They would have won the match if their best player ___ injured.
gaps.hint: unreal past needs the past perfect
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition requires the past perfect: had not been.

gaps.sentence: If this medicine ___ relief within an hour, call me back.
gaps.explanation: Conditional instructions use the present simple in the if-clause: does not bring.
